data.rationale: 'After a set amount of time' means a lifetime relative to creation, supplied in seconds; an absolute timestamp input is not needed.
data.title: Assumption A10

data.rationale: Aliases live in the same namespace as generated codes and are case-sensitive, like generated codes.
data.title: Assumption A11

data.rationale: Expiry is not retroactive: links that exist today never expire and cannot be given a lifetime in this change.
data.title: Assumption A12

data.rationale: Accept expires_in_seconds, compute expires_at once at creation from the server clock and store that. Consequences: One comparison per redirect; the stored value is unambiguous. Changing a link's lifetime later needs a new endpoint.
data.title: ADR-6: Relative lifetime in, absolute expiry stored

data.rationale: Check expiry when the link is resolved; a link is gone when now >= expires_at. No background job. Consequences: Exact, race-free behaviour with no moving parts. Expired rows remain until a retention policy exists.
data.title: ADR-7: Lazy expiry, inclusive of the expiry instant

data.rationale: Store the alias in links.code. The primary key gives uniqueness atomically; a conflict is reported as 409 and never retried or substituted. Consequences: No new query on the redirect path. The existing code syntax check must admit '-' and '_' and three-character codes, which changes one existing test on purpose.
data.title: ADR-8: Aliases share the code namespace

data.rationale: Refuse a case-insensitive list of reserved names, and keep service routes registered before the catch-all redirect route. Consequences: Existing links keep their URLs. New top-level routes must be added to the reserved list.
data.title: ADR-9: Reserved names instead of a separate URL prefix

data.rationale: Migration 2 only adds a nullable column and a defaulted column; no rewrite, no backfill. Consequences: Instant on any table size and safe to roll the application back: release 1.0 reads rows by column name and ignores the new columns.
data.title: ADR-10: Additive migration only
